# Vendored third-party sources

This directory contains source snapshots incorporated into KLink-dotnet.
Each vendored project retains its own version and license notices; see the
project directory's `README.md`, `VENDOR.md`, and `LICENSE` before building,
modifying, or redistributing it.

The current `fyserver` snapshot is in `fyserver/`. It is built as part of the
KLink-dotnet integration and references the sibling `KLink.Bot` project.
